shots.why: Frame 0: low drone toward the moon; runners with glowing eggs cross the lens, the beams behind; the dragon crosses the moon; Kit stands still, empty-handed.
The hook face: Kit, still and empty-handed, wonder on her face, turns her head toward the clock.
shots.subject: kit

shots.why: Never hold one: the clock at 11:59 (insert ≤ 1.2 s).
At midnight: a kid flings away a red-pulsing egg like it burns.
shots.subject: r1

shots.why: Every kid has a base: the Ember base, its kid guarding the glowing nest, the street behind.
Every base has a nest: a kid stands proudly over the Frost nest, the egg glowing.
shots.subject: r3

shots.why: Grab an egg. Run: behind a runner leaving the Sprinkle base.
Lock your door for sixty seconds: a kid dives in, the door slams, the bolt shoots across and the brass dial starts to count.
Somebody steals it right back: the Moss egg lifted from its nest.
There is a scoreboard on the town hall: a kid lifts an egg through a window; tilt up to DAX 200 on top.
Most eggs wins: Dax sprints across the square, arms full, kids chasing.
Grandmas play: a grandma tiptoes off, an egg tucked under her arm, a sly smile at us.
shots.subject: grandma

shots.why: Mailmen play: the mailman pulls eggs out of his mailbag.
shots.subject: mailman

shots.why: The mayor plays; at one minute to midnight a kid stares at the egg in her hands (S13 mayor merged in after three failed contrast passes, owner pass 2).
shots.subject: r5

shots.why: The whole town plays hot potato: crane over the square, eggs flying hand to hand (looking south: no clock).
Clue 2: three deep claw gouges torn into a kid's wooden door, moonlit; the door edge and handle in frame.
Gone by morning: the same base at dawn, empty, one cold egg in the nest.
Then there is Kit: eleven, walking toward us, and she walks right past a glowing egg without touching it.
shots.subject: kit

shots.why: She found an egg once and returned it, with a sorry note: she walks in holding it, toward us, and sets it back in its nest, then the note.
Her score is zero; it has always been zero: the whole scoreboard, the camera creeping in on KIT 0 at the bottom (the vault shot was cut, owner pass 2).
Her big brother Dax is number one: two hundred eggs piled in his arms, kids gathered round.
He calls her the slowest thief alive: Dax laughs.
shots.subject: dax

shots.why: She just keeps saying excuse me: the queue faces us, a kid cuts in, Kit at the end waves politely.
shots.subject: kit

shots.why: But Kit notices things; running kids do not: runners blur past behind her.
shots.subject: kit

shots.why: The town is full of eggs, but nobody has ever seen a bird: rooftop nests, the dragon weathervane against the stars (clue 1), Kit looking up, AFK frozen by a wall.
The eggs are cold, always cold: the Plain egg in Kit's still hands (clue 3, spoken).
Unless you stand very still: Kit does not move, runners blur past behind her, and the egg warms from cold blue to gold.
shots.subject: kit

shots.why: Nobody else stands still long enough: runners streak past the one still girl.
shots.subject: kit

shots.why: One night Dax got greedy: tracking him running, arms full, grinning; one more egg, just one more.
shots.subject: dax

shots.why: The clock: 11:59, the hand clicks to twelve (insert ≤ 1.3 s).
The clock struck twelve: back view on purpose, Dax runs off down the street as a shadow sweeps over the houses and cobbles (he is never shown taken).
shots.subject: dax

shots.why: In the morning his bed was empty: Kit beside it.
One feather on his pillow: one long gold-orange feather, quill and soft vanes, swaying a little.
It was bigger than Kit: Kit stands beside the bed facing us, the feather on it longer than she is tall.
shots.subject: kit

shots.why: So that night Kit did the unthinkable: she tiptoes to the nest nobody wanted and lifts the Plain egg out.
She was terrible at it: she bows to the empty nest to say sorry, facing us across it.
shots.subject: kit

shots.why: She walks to the middle of town and stops; the town gathers in a ring.
shots.subject: kit

shots.why: One minute to midnight: Kit, the egg in her hands, determined.
shots.subject: kit

shots.why: The whole town screamed, Kit, drop it!: the ring of faces shouting, a kid pointing at her.
Kit held on: the egg at her chest, her hands at its sides, her face above it in wonder, the crack spreading, its light on her face.
shots.subject: kit

shots.why: The bell rang twelve times and the shadow came down: Kit in the middle of the frozen ring looks up, the shadow crossing her.
shots.subject: kit

shots.why: Its wings were as wide as the street: she flies in front of a huge moon, wings spread wider than she is long, rim-lit, eyes glowing.
shots.subject: mother

shots.why: It was not a bird. It was a dragon. Very, very gently: her head comes down from the top of the frame to Kit, eyes soft, lit by the egg; Kit looks up (the twist).
shots.subject: kit

shots.why: It lifted Kit into the clouds (S40 merged in, owner pass 2). Money shot: drone low over the sunrise clouds onto a woven nest the size of the town, kids and baby dragons in a ring, the mother curled outside.
Every missing kid was in it, even Dax: Dax in the ring facing us, a hatchling asleep on his head, the other kids round him.
shots.subject: dax

shots.why: Each one had a baby dragon asleep in their lap: Little and her frost baby, both facing us, the baby wiggling.
shots.subject: little

shots.why: Proof match cut (flashback): one big cold blue egg flying hand to hand in the town at night…
…cut to a gold egg in still hands: Kit in the nest holding it, her face lit.
shots.subject: kit

shots.why: Not one had ever hatched: the camera rises over the ring in the nest.
Kit's egg cracked; a tiny gold dragon sneezed on her: held at her chest beside her face, both faces visible, sparkles behind (laugh 3).
shots.subject: kit

shots.why: The mother was not taking thieves; she was taking babysitters: a kid in the ring with her baby, the mother's head resting on the rim above them.
shots.subject: r1

shots.why: Dax came home the next morning: the dragons fly in over the square at sunrise.
On a dragon: Dax on the saddle of her back, face and arms up against the sunrise sky.
shots.subject: dax

shots.why: That night nobody played hot potato: an egg left on a bench; AFK, still frozen, a hatchling asleep on his head (cameo 2).
The scoreboard got a new word, HATCHED; Kit is number one: Kit laughing at us, the board flipping behind her.
shots.subject: kit

shots.why: In this town everybody steals eggs: now the kids sit still, gold eggs glowing in their laps.
shots.subject: kit

shots.why: And at midnight everybody holds on: the same drone path, the whole town sitting still on the square, gold eggs in every lap.
